author: sungeunk
title: GPU unit tests fail to extract OpenVINO package - tbb12.dll locked (Access denied) on Windows self-hosted runner
signature: remove item cannot remove item access to the path is denied unauthorizedaccessexception|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step failed: Remove-Item could not delete runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin/tbb12.dll - Access to the path is denied (UnauthorizedAccessException)

key_errors: 2026-11-10T10:06:28.2994257Z Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied.
root_cause: The 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step re-extracts the OpenVINO package zip onto a self-hosted Windows runner workspace left over from a prior job. Expand-Archive -Force tries to overwrite/replace tbb12.dll inside runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin, but the file is still memory-mapped/locked by a lingering process (commonly a previous test binary or antivirus scanner holding an open handle) on that persistent runner, so Remove-Item throws UnauthorizedAccessException and the step exits with code 1. This is a known recurring Windows self-hosted runner workspace-cleanliness issue (pattern 95bb23aa2ed8a84d), not caused by the PR's code changes.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires a stale/locked DLL handle on the specific self-hosted Windows GPU runner (ov-dmz-35); not reproducible from a clean checkout or in a fresh CI runner.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'GPU unit tests' job; a clean runner slot typically resolves the lock.

Investigate why tbb12.dll remains locked after prior jobs on self-hosted Windows GPU runners (e.g., a GPU test process or OS handle not released before archive extraction) and add a workspace/process cleanup step before Expand-Archive.
Consider adding a retry-with-backoff wrapper around the Extract OpenVINO packages step for Windows self-hosted runners, or running extraction to a fresh directory instead of overwriting in place.
prevention_strategies: Ensure self-hosted Windows GPU runners fully release file handles (terminate lingering test processes, flush antivirus scans) before starting a new job's package extraction; alternatively extract to a clean, uniquely-named directory per run instead of reusing/overwriting the previous job's install directory.
historical_context: This exact signature (tbb12.dll Access to the path is denied during Extract OpenVINO packages) has recurred 5 times before this run between 2026-11-09T19:06:46Z and 2026-11-10T08:35:09Z, affecting PRs #39668, #39034, and #39444. It is tracked as an ongoing Infrastructure issue on Windows self-hosted GPU runners in pattern 95bb23aa2ed8a84d.
